body.name: Clean-through-terminal localized observed model
body.construction:
Let \(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{loc}}\) be the class of observed laws \(P\) satisfying, for every \(k=(g,t)\), \(k'=(g,t')\in\mathcal K\) with the same target cohort, every \(u\in\{g,\ldots,\min(t,t')\}\), every \(c\in\mathcal J_k\), and every \(c'\in\mathcal J_{k'}\),
\[
d_{c,u}(X)=d_{c',u}(X)\quad P_X\text{-almost surely}.
\]
This is the larger clean-through-terminal localized equality model.  It omits OVS rows involving a cohort that is clean at \(u\) but not through a selected terminal period.
